description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus replay-backed fragment flow, chemistry-aware composition and convergence-aware assembly planning for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

fragmentFlowIndex.purpose: Catalog replay-observed composition transitions plus same-solution convergence motifs.
fragmentFlowIndex.transitions: Canonical pairwise fragment-flow edges aggregated across solutions.

convergenceMotifs.purpose: Preserve evidence that multiple concrete predecessor fragments converged on the same target fragment instance in one replayed solution.
convergenceMotifs.inputMultiplicity: preserved even when multiple inputs use the same canonical mechanism

chemistryAwareComposition.purpose: Match manufacturing operations to replay-observed functional relations.

convergenceAwareAssembly.purpose: Construct replay-backed DAG candidates when a manufacturing plan requires multiple reagent streams to converge.
algorithm: select a same-solution convergence motif with enough concrete inputs
find feed-origin paths to every required motif input
find an output-bound path from the convergence target
combine branch relations, one semantic convergence relation and tail relations
reject candidates missing any manufacturing-required functional relation
limitations: A convergence motif proves historical same-solution convergence, not that its geometry can be transplanted unchanged into a new puzzle.
Current branch selection uses the best empirical path to each motif input rather than global combinatorial optimization.
Placed geometry, program synchronization and collision validation remain downstream solver responsibilities.
